response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s AS (SELECT throws, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS combined_tally, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
